entities.summary: Alvaro Fernandes Dias is a Brazilian politician. He had represented Paraná in the Federal Senate from 1999 to 2023. Previously, he was the governor of Paraná. He is a member of Podemos. Alvaro Dias was a journalists & chroniclers from Quatá (b. 1944-12-07, Quatá). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
